Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the pre-operative image (Figure 1a), which shows a massive right-sided opacity causing leftward mediastinal shift, with the post-operative image (Figure 1c), there is clear resolution of the mass and re-expansion of the right lung; however, residual volume loss or atelectasis indicates only partial re-expansion, and the heart and trachea remain shifted to the left relative to the midline.
